definition: to not get somewhere in time
description: A small mountain railway station in falling snow at dusk. A young woman in a blue ski suit, a padded vest, a knitted hat and ski boots runs through the snow along the platform with skis and a pole in her arms, reaching out towards a red and cream train that keeps moving beside her. A conductor in a cap leans out of the open door and stretches out his hand, friends in ski gear wave from a window, and a porter with a luggage trolley stands by the lit wooden station hut.

taps.phrase: to lean out of the doorway
